description: The spend meter and budget gate for AI voice agents. Meters STT + TTS + LLM + telephony per call, out of the box (Pipecat, LiveKit — Python & TypeScript). Hard-stops the next turn before it crosses your ceiling. Local, no account, no telemetry. Built by Floe — cost controls for Voice AI.
